title: Activity bar
description: Vertical view switcher at the window edge: view icons (top) and Accounts/Manage (bottom), with active indicator and badges.
usage: Left edge of a full-window layout (44px wide incl. gutter). Children: <vsc-activity-item>; bottom items in slot="bottom". Without children renders the default views.

examples.title: Search active
examples.html: <vsc-activitybar style="height: 833px;"><vsc-activity-item icon="explorer-view-icon" label="Explorer (Ctrl+Shift+E)"></vsc-activity-item><vsc-activity-item icon="search-view-icon" label="Search (Ctrl+Shift+F)" checked></vsc-activity-item><vsc-activity-item icon="source-control-view-icon" label="Source Control (Ctrl+Shift+G)"></vsc-activity-item><vsc-activity-item icon="run-view-icon" label="Run and Debug (Ctrl+Shift+D)"></vsc-activity-item><vsc-activity-item icon="extensions-view-icon" label="Extensions (Ctrl+Shift+X)"></vsc-activity-item></vsc-activitybar>

examples.title: With a badge
examples.html: <vsc-activitybar style="height: 400px;"><vsc-activity-item icon="explorer-view-icon" label="Explorer (Ctrl+Shift+E)" checked></vsc-activity-item><vsc-activity-item icon="search-view-icon" label="Search (Ctrl+Shift+F)"></vsc-activity-item><vsc-activity-item icon="source-control-view-icon" label="Source Control (Ctrl+Shift+G)" badge="3"></vsc-activity-item><vsc-activity-item icon="extensions-view-icon" label="Extensions (Ctrl+Shift+X)" badge="1"></vsc-activity-item></vsc-activitybar>
